title: Vanilla Essence
description: This is Minecraft with some QoL-mods.
body:
This modpack is designed for players who love the classic Vanilla Minecraft experience but want a few smart improvements — without changing the core gameplay. It combines subtle quality-of-life features, performance optimizations, and visual enhancements to make your game smoother and more enjoyable. 

Key Features:
- Keeps the Vanilla Feel: No major gameplay changes, just small additions for better comfort.
- Performance & Stability: Mods like Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and ImmediatelyFast boost FPS and reduce lag.
- Visual Upgrades: Iris for shaders and Distant Horizons for stunning render distances.
- Quality-of-Life Enhancements: AppleSkin, Inventory Profiles Next, Controlling, Jade, and more for easier gameplay.
- Multiplayer Extras: Plasmo Voice and Simple Voice Chat for better communication.
- Compatibility: Runs on Fabric and optimized for a wide player base.

Perfect for anyone looking for an optimized, modern Vanilla experience — ideal for survival, multiplayer, and large worlds.
